findings: Unconditional online indicator — Green dot shows for all visitors regardless of connection state. Check visitorOnline or socket presence and conditionally render the indicator only when true.

Website URL fallback breaks for null currentPageUrl — getWebsiteDisplay() returns 'from website' when currentPageUrl is null, which is uninformative. Consider showing 'from [unknown]' or hiding the line entirely when no URL data exists.

Hash-based avatar colors untested for collisions — Simple bitwise hash across 8 colors may produce uneven distribution or collisions for common visitor name patterns. Verify distribution across actual visitor data or use a proven hash function.
Typing indicator variable naming confusion — visitorTyping is never defined but typing state is used. Verify the typing indicator logic connects to the correct socket event and state variable.
summary: Premium inbox redesign successfully implements Jivo-style conversation cards with gradient avatars, structured layout, and consistent UI polish. TypeScript compilation passes. Four issues require attention: hardcoded online indicator (all visitors show green dot), uninformative website fallback text for missing URL data, untested avatar color hash distribution, and potential typing indicator state inconsistency.
